mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_financials (stock_code, base_year, period_code, revenue, operating_profit, net_income, total_assets, total_debt, total_equity, current_assets, current_liabilities, finance_costs, operating_cash_flow, debt_ratio, operating_margin, roe, current_ratio, interest_coverage) VALUES (#{stockCode}, #{baseYear}, #{periodCode}, #{revenue}, #{operatingProfit}, #{netIncome}, #{totalAssets}, #{totalDebt}, #{totalEquity}, #{currentAssets}, #{currentLiabilities}, #{financeCosts}, #{operatingCashFlow}, #{debtRatio}, #{operatingMargin}, #{roe}, #{currentRatio}, #{interestCoverage}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE revenue=VALUES(revenue), operating_profit=VALUES(operating_profit), net_income=VALUES(net_income), total_assets=VALUES(total_assets), total_debt=VALUES(total_debt), total_equity=VALUES(total_equity), current_assets=VALUES(current_assets), current_liabilities=VALUES(current_liabilities), finance_costs=VALUES(finance_costs), operating_cash_flow=VALUES(operating_cash_flow), debt_ratio=VALUES(debt_ratio), operating_margin=VALUES(operating_margin), roe=VALUES(roe), current_ratio=VALUES(current_ratio), interest_coverage=VALUES(interest_coverage)
mapper.select: SELECT content FROM stock_reports WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} AND DATE(generated_at) = CURDATE() ORDER BY generated_at DESC LIMIT 1
